programs.title: The Shadow of an Empire Ep.2
programs.desc: Visit the Eastern Qing Tombs at the foot of Changrui Mountain in Zunhua, Hebei, the burial site of China's last imperial dynasty. Resting here are the Emperors Shunzhi and Kangxi, as well as the Empress Dowager Cixi and other Qing royalty. Through these tombs, the documentary brings to life the former glory and fading echoes of the Great Qing Empire.
